span.div:
Lock key format: "dblock:{table_name}:{row_id}"
TTL: 5 seconds (operations complete in under 500ms)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Deadlock prevention: lock ordering by row_id
Operation on row_1 and row_3: acquire row_1
lock, then row_3 lock
Operation on row_3 and row_1: acquire row_1
lock, then row_3 lock
(Always acquire locks in ascending row_id
order)
